shell.storage: The browser could not save your progress. Results are available in this session but may disappear after reloading.
shell.motto: TenseLab · From knowing rules to fluent practice
shell.device: Progress is saved on this device
drill.title: From rules to fluent practice.
drill.intro: One phrase. Forms in this round: {count}. Say it aloud, then check.
drill.subject: S is your pronoun. Use the correct verb form.
drill.shortcuts: Space: answer. Right arrow: next form. Audio plays only when requested.
formula.label: Formula: {formula}
drill.step1: Say the forms of your chosen tenses aloud using the table — about 2 minutes.
drill.step2: Open Translation and practice without hints — about 7 minutes.
drill.step3: Revisit mistakes and check yourself — about 3 minutes.
drill.step4: Add a short real dialogue from a source of your choice: a table cannot replace context.
translation.title: Meaning first. Then form.
translation.intro: Translate aloud or write your version. Use the model answer to check the structure.
translation.input: Your answer — you can also say it aloud
translation.self: Self-assessment · other translations may be valid
translation.note: Russian prompts include time cues. In real speech, context determines the structure; matching the model does not replace a teacher's assessment.
comparison.spoken: Say your answer aloud and assess yourself.
comparison.other: Your answer: {answer} · Compare the structure yourself; alternatives may be correct.
progress.title: Small steps. Every day.
progress.intro: Translations and completed drills, today and over time.
progress.reached: Goal reached. Stop for today or continue at your own pace.
progress.practice: A little practice every day. Accuracy matters more than speed.
progress.empty: Start with one translation card: reveal the answer and assess yourself to see your first result here.
progress.explain: Translations count after self-assessment, including “Needs practice”. “Got it” is your own assessment. A drill counts after you advance through every card in the set and finish the last one. Jumping to a card alone does not complete it. These numbers measure practice, not English proficiency or pronunciation.
progress.local: This browser keeps your data across app updates. Export a backup before clearing site data or switching browsers: there is no automatic synchronization.
progress.confirm: Reset translations, drills and daily history? A local copy will be saved first. Download an export before resetting for reliable recovery.
reference.title: See the whole system.
reference.intro: Compare one idea across structures. Select cells to choose tenses for your drill.
reference.help: Select a cell to add a tense; select it again to remove it. The drill includes all three forms of each tense.
reference.selected: Tenses selected: {count} of 12 · forms in the round: {forms}
speech.unavailable: Speech is unavailable in this browser. Say the phrase yourself.
speech.error: Could not read the phrase aloud. Check that an English voice is available on your device.
usage.title: {tense} — examples
progress.calendarHelp: Last 12 months. Select a day for details. Use the arrow keys to move through the calendar and Enter to select a day.
progress.historySince: Detailed tracking since {date}. Earlier totals are preserved; past drills and unrecorded days cannot be reconstructed.
progress.partialDay: The old version saved {count} translations for this day without correctness details. “+” shows only newly recorded correct answers; the full day’s accuracy is unknown.
progress.noHistory: Detailed tracking had not started on this day. Zero means no records, rather than no practice.
progress.emptyDay: No recorded practice for this day yet.
progress.timezone: The day uses your device’s local time when an exercise finishes. Changing time zones does not move earlier records to different dates.
progress.environment: You are using {channel}. The main app, demo and each PR store separate progress. A different address, port or browser may also show different data. Use export and import to transfer it.
progress.importHelp: Import replaces all current statistics without adding totals. Importing the same file again never doubles results. A local copy is saved before replacement. Accepts a JSON export or a raw version 2 record, up to 5 MB.
progress.importPreview: Backup: translations — {done}, drills — {drills}. Current: translations — {current}, drills — {currentDrills}.
progress.replaceWarning: All current history will be replaced by this backup. Download your current backup first if you want a separate copy.
progress.importError: Could not read this backup. Check the JSON format, version and file size. Current data has not changed.
progress.legacyError: No suitable old HTML record was found, or its format is damaged. Original data has not changed.
progress.originalError: The browser blocked access to the original record. Allow site storage access and try again.
progress.exported: The backup file is ready to download.
progress.imported: Statistics restored. The previous record was saved in a local backup.
progress.saveError: Replacement failed. Check the storage error message; current data has not been deleted.
progress.resetDone: Statistics reset. A local copy of the previous data was saved.
progress.problem.read: Could not read browser storage. New practice is tracked only in this tab. Allow site storage access to restore saving.
progress.problem.invalid: The stored record is damaged or uses another app version. It has not been overwritten. Only this session’s practice is shown; automatic saving is paused.
progress.problem.write: Could not save progress: browser storage may be full or unavailable. Practice remains in this tab for now. The next answer will retry saving.
progress.problem.conflict: Another tab changed the statistics. Its data is protected from overwriting. New results from this tab have not been saved yet.
progress.noCopies: No local backups in this version yet. Download an export to keep a copy outside the browser.
